132uint32_t CS3Trio64::latch_start_addr()
133{
134 if (s3.memory_config & 0x08)
135 {
136 // - SDD scrolling test expects a << 2 for 8bpp and no shift for anything else
137 // - Slackware 3.x XF86_S3 expect a << 2 shift (to be confirmed)
138 // - przonegd expect no shift (RGB16)
139 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch << (svga.rgb8_en ? 2 : 0);
140 }
141 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch;
142}

161void CS3Trio64::s3_define_video_mode()
162{
163 int divisor = 1;
164 int xtal = ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) ? XTAL(28'636'363) : XTAL(25'174'800)).value();
165 double freq;
166
167 if ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) == 0x0c)
168 {
169 // DCLK calculation
170 freq = ((double)(s3.clk_pll_m + 2) / (double)((s3.clk_pll_n + 2) * (pow(2.0, s3.clk_pll_r)))) * 14.318; // clock between XIN and XOUT
171 xtal = freq * 1000000;
172 }
173
174 if ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4)
175 {
176 svga.rgb8_en = 0;
177 svga.rgb15_en = 0;
178 svga.rgb16_en = 0;
179 svga.rgb32_en = 0;
180 // FIXME: vision864 has only first 7 modes
181 switch ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4)
182 {
183 // 0001 Mode 8: 2x 8-bit 1 VCLK/2 pixels
184 case 0x01: svga.rgb8_en = 1; break;
185 // 0010 Mode 1: 15-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
186 case 0x02: svga.rgb15_en = 1; break;
187 // 0011 Mode 9: 15-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
188 case 0x03: svga.rgb15_en = 1; divisor = 2; break;
189 // 0100 Mode 2: 24-bit 3 VCLK/pixel
190 case 0x04: svga.rgb24_en = 1; break;
191 // 0101 Mode 10: 16-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
192 case 0x05: svga.rgb16_en = 1; divisor = 2; break;
193 // 0110 Mode 3: 16-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
194 case 0x06: svga.rgb16_en = 1; break;
195 // 0111 Mode 11: 24/32-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
196 case 0x07: svga.rgb32_en = 1; divisor = 4; break;
197 case 0x0d: svga.rgb32_en = 1; divisor = 1; break;
198 default:
199 printf("%s: Unsupported pixel color mode %02x.\n", devid_string, ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4));
200 break;
201 }
202 }
203 else
204 {
205 // 0000: Mode 0 8-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
206 svga.rgb8_en = (s3.memory_config & 8) >> 3;
207 svga.rgb15_en = 0;
208 svga.rgb16_en = 0;
209 svga.rgb32_en = 0;
210 }
211
212#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_RENDER
213 LOGCRTC("%s: define_video_mode: ext_misc_ctrl_2=%02x memory_config=%02x "
214 "rgb8=%d rgb15=%d rgb16=%d rgb32=%d crtc_offset=%03x offset()=%d\n",
215 devid_string, s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2, s3.memory_config,
216 svga.rgb8_en, svga.rgb15_en, svga.rgb16_en, svga.rgb32_en,
217 vga.crtc.offset, offset());
218#endif
219
220 recompute_params_clock(divisor, xtal);
221}

223void CS3Trio64::refresh_pitch_offset()
224{
225 // bit 2 = bit 8 of offset register, but only if bits 4-5 of CR51 are 00h.
226 vga.crtc.offset &= 0xff;
227 if ((s3.cr51 & 0x30) == 0)
228 vga.crtc.offset |= (s3.cr43 & 0x04) << 6;
229 else
230 vga.crtc.offset |= (s3.cr51 & 0x30) << 4;
231}

233void CS3Trio64::crtc_map(address_map& map)
234{
235 map(0x00, 0x00).lrw8(
236 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
237 return vga.crtc.horz_total & 0xff;
238 }),
239 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
240 // doom (DOS) tries to write to protected regs
241 LOGCRTC("%s: CR00 H total %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
242 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
243 return;
244 vga.crtc.horz_total = (vga.crtc.horz_total & ~0xff) | (data & 0xff);
245 LOGCRTC("%04d\n", vga.crtc.horz_total);
246 recompute_params();
247 })
248 );
249 map(0x01, 0x01).lrw8(
250 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
251 return vga.crtc.horz_disp_end & 0xff;
252 }),
253 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
254 LOGCRTC("%s: CR01 H display end %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
255 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
256 return;
257 vga.crtc.horz_disp_end = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end & ~0xff) | (data & 0xff);
258 LOGCRTC("%04d\n", vga.crtc.horz_disp_end);
259 recompute_params();
260 })
261 );
262 map(0x02, 0x02).lrw8(
263 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
264 return vga.crtc.horz_blank_start & 0xff;
265 }),
266 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
267 LOGCRTC("%s: CR02 H start blank %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
268 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
269 return;
270 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_start & ~0xff) | (data & 0xff);
271 LOGCRTC("%04d\n", vga.crtc.horz_blank_start);
272 })
273 );
274 map(0x03, 0x03).lrw8(
275 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
276 u8 res = vga.crtc.horz_blank_end & 0x1f;
277 res |= (vga.crtc.disp_enable_skew & 3) << 5;
278 res |= (vga.crtc.evra & 1) << 7;
279 return res;
280 }),
281 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
282 LOGCRTC("%s: CR03 H blank end %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
283 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
284 return;
285 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end &= ~0x1f;
286 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end |= data & 0x1f;
287 vga.crtc.disp_enable_skew = (data & 0x60) >> 5;
288 vga.crtc.evra = BIT(data, 7);
289 LOGCRTC("%04d evra %d display enable skew %01x\n", vga.crtc.horz_blank_end, vga.crtc.evra, vga.crtc.disp_enable_skew);
290 })
291 );
292 map(0x04, 0x04).lrw8(
293 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
294 return vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start & 0xff;
295 }),
296 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
297 LOGCRTC("%s: CR04 H retrace start %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
298 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
299 return;
300 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start & ~0xff) | (data & 0xff);
301 LOGCRTC("%04d\n", vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start);
302 })
303 );
304 map(0x05, 0x05).lrw8(
305 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
306 u8 res = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_end & 0x20) << 2;
307 res |= (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_skew & 3) << 5;
308 res |= (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end & 0x1f);
309 return res;
310 }),
311 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
312 LOGCRTC("%s: CR05 H blank end %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
313 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
314 return;
315 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end &= ~0x20;
316 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end |= ((data & 0x80) >> 2);
317 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_skew = ((data & 0x60) >> 5);
318 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end & ~0x1f) | (data & 0x1f);
319 LOGCRTC("%04d retrace skew %01d retrace end %02d\n"
320 , vga.crtc.horz_blank_end
321 , vga.crtc.horz_retrace_skew
322 , vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end
323 );
324 })
325 );
326 map(0x06, 0x06).lrw8(
327 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
328 return vga.crtc.vert_total & 0xff;
329 }),
330 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
331 LOGCRTC("%s: CR06 V total %02x %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "-> ");
332 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
333 return;
334 vga.crtc.vert_total &= ~0xff;
335 vga.crtc.vert_total |= data & 0xff;
336 LOGCRTC("%04d\n", vga.crtc.vert_total);
337 recompute_params();
338 })
339 );
340 // Overflow Register
341 map(0x07, 0x07).lrw8(
342 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
343 u8 res = (vga.crtc.line_compare & 0x100) >> 4;
344 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0x200) >> 2;
345 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end & 0x200) >> 3;
346 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_total & 0x200) >> 4;
347 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_blank_start & 0x100) >> 5;
348 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0x100) >> 6;
349 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end & 0x100) >> 7;
350 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_total & 0x100) >> 8;
351 return res;
352 }),
353 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
354 vga.crtc.line_compare &= ~0x100;
355 vga.crtc.line_compare |= ((data & 0x10) << (8 - 4));
356 LOGCRTC("%s: CR07 Overflow %02x -> line compare %04d %s", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.line_compare, vga.crtc.protect_enable ? "P?\n" : "");
357 if (vga.crtc.protect_enable)
358 return;
359 vga.crtc.vert_total &= ~0x300;
360 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start &= ~0x300;
361 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end &= ~0x300;
362 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start &= ~0x100;
363 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start |= ((data & 0x80) << (9 - 7));
364 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end |= ((data & 0x40) << (9 - 6));
365 vga.crtc.vert_total |= ((data & 0x20) << (9 - 5));
366 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start |= ((data & 0x08) << (8 - 3));
367 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start |= ((data & 0x04) << (8 - 2));
368 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end |= ((data & 0x02) << (8 - 1));
369 vga.crtc.vert_total |= ((data & 0x01) << (8 - 0));
370 LOGCRTC("V total %04d V retrace start %04d V display end %04d V blank start %04d\n"
371 , vga.crtc.vert_total
372 , vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start
373 , vga.crtc.vert_disp_end
374 , vga.crtc.vert_blank_start
375 );
376 recompute_params();
377 })
378 );
379 // Preset Row Scan Register
380 map(0x08, 0x08).lrw8(
381 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
382 u8 res = (vga.crtc.byte_panning & 3) << 5;
383 res |= (vga.crtc.preset_row_scan & 0x1f);
384 return res;
385 }),
386 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
387 vga.crtc.byte_panning = (data & 0x60) >> 5;
388 vga.crtc.preset_row_scan = (data & 0x1f);
389 LOGCRTC("%s: CR08 Preset Row Scan %02x -> %02d byte panning %d\n"
390 , devid_string, data
391 , vga.crtc.preset_row_scan
392 , vga.crtc.byte_panning
393 );
394 })
395 );
396 // Maximum Scan Line Register
397 map(0x09, 0x09).lrw8(
398 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
399 u8 res = (vga.crtc.maximum_scan_line - 1) & 0x1f;
400 res |= (vga.crtc.scan_doubling & 1) << 7;
401 res |= (vga.crtc.line_compare & 0x200) >> 3;
402 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_blank_start & 0x200) >> 4;
403 return res;
404 }),
405 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
406 vga.crtc.line_compare &= ~0x200;
407 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start &= ~0x200;
408 vga.crtc.scan_doubling = ((data & 0x80) >> 7);
409 vga.crtc.line_compare |= ((data & 0x40) << (9 - 6));
410 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start |= ((data & 0x20) << (9 - 5));
411 vga.crtc.maximum_scan_line = (data & 0x1f) + 1;
412 LOGCRTC("%s: CR09 Maximum Scan Line %02x -> %02d V blank start %04d line compare %04d scan doubling %d\n"
413 , devid_string, data
414 , vga.crtc.maximum_scan_line
415 , vga.crtc.vert_blank_start
416 , vga.crtc.line_compare
417 , vga.crtc.scan_doubling
418 );
419 })
420 );
421 map(0x0a, 0x0a).lrw8(
422 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
423 u8 res = (vga.crtc.cursor_scan_start & 0x1f);
424 res |= ((vga.crtc.cursor_enable & 1) ^ 1) << 5;
425 return res;
426 }),
427 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
428 vga.crtc.cursor_enable = ((data & 0x20) ^ 0x20) >> 5;
429 vga.crtc.cursor_scan_start = data & 0x1f;
430 state.vga_mem_updated = 1; // text mode: cursor shape change trigger
431 })
432 );
433 map(0x0b, 0x0b).lrw8(
434 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
435 u8 res = (vga.crtc.cursor_skew & 3) << 5;
436 res |= (vga.crtc.cursor_scan_end & 0x1f);
437 return res;
438 }),
439 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
440 vga.crtc.cursor_skew = (data & 0x60) >> 5;
441 vga.crtc.cursor_scan_end = data & 0x1f;
442 state.vga_mem_updated = 1; // text mode: cursor shape change trigger
443 })
444 );
445 map(0x0c, 0x0d).lrw8(
446 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
447 return (vga.crtc.start_addr_latch >> ((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8) & 0xff;
448 }),
449 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
450 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~(0xff << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
451 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= (data << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
452 state.vga_mem_updated = 1; // text mode: cursor shape change trigger
453 })
454 );
455 map(0x0e, 0x0f).lrw8(
456 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
457 return (vga.crtc.cursor_addr >> ((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8) & 0xff;
458 }),
459 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
460 vga.crtc.cursor_addr &= ~(0xff << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
461 vga.crtc.cursor_addr |= (data << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
462 state.vga_mem_updated = 1; // text mode: cursor shape change trigger
463 })
464 );
465 map(0x10, 0x10).lrw8(
466 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
467 return vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0xff;
468 }),
469 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
470 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start &= ~0xff;
471 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start |= data & 0xff;
472 LOGCRTC("%s: CR10 V retrace start %02x -> %04d\n", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start);
473 })
474 );
475 map(0x11, 0x11).lrw8(
476 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
477 u8 res = (vga.crtc.protect_enable & 1) << 7;
478 res |= (vga.crtc.bandwidth & 1) << 6;
479 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_end & 0xf);
480 res |= (vga.crtc.irq_clear & 1) << 4;
481 res |= (vga.crtc.irq_disable & 1) << 5;
482 return res;
483 }),
484 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
485 vga.crtc.protect_enable = BIT(data, 7);
486 vga.crtc.bandwidth = BIT(data, 6);
487 // IRQ: Original VGA only supports this for PS/2, but clone cards may supports this on ISA too
488 // see https://scalibq.wordpress.com/2022/12/06/the-myth-of-the-vertical-retrace-interrupt/
489 vga.crtc.irq_disable = BIT(data, 5);
490 vga.crtc.irq_clear = BIT(data, 4);
491 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_end = (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_end & ~0xf) | (data & 0x0f);
492
493 if (vga.crtc.irq_clear == 0)
494 {
495 vga.crtc.irq_latch = 0;
496 m_vsync_cb(0);
497 }
498
499 LOGCRTC("%s: CR11 V retrace end %02x -> %02d protect enable %d bandwidth %d irq %02x\n"
500 , devid_string, data
501 , vga.crtc.vert_retrace_end
502 , vga.crtc.protect_enable
503 , vga.crtc.bandwidth
504 , data & 0x30
505 );
506 })
507 );
508 map(0x12, 0x12).lrw8(
509 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
510 return vga.crtc.vert_disp_end & 0xff;
511 }),
512 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
513 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end &= ~0xff;
514 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end |= data & 0xff;
515 LOGCRTC("%s: CR12 V display end %02x -> %04d\n", devid_string, data, vga.crtc.vert_disp_end);
516 recompute_params();
517 })
518 );
519 map(0x13, 0x13).lrw8(
520 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
521 return vga.crtc.offset & 0xff;
522 }),
523 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
524 vga.crtc.offset &= ~0xff;

805 /*
806 CR45 Hardware Graphics Cursor Mode
807 bit 0 HWGC ENB. Hardware Graphics Cursor Enable. Set to enable the
808 HardWare Cursor in VGA and enhanced modes.
809 1 (911/24) Delay Timing for Pattern Data Fetch
810 2 (801/5,928) Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch 2. If set the cursor
811 pixels are stretched horizontally to two bytes and items 0 and 1 of
812 the fore/background stacks in 3d4h index 4Ah/4Bh are used.
813 3 (801/5,928) Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch 3. If set the cursor
814 pixels are stretched horizontally to three bytes and items 0,1 and
815 2 of the fore/background stacks in 3d4h index 4Ah/4Bh are used.
816 2-3 (805i,864/964) HWC-CSEL. Hardware Cursor Color Select.
817 0: 4/8bit, 1: 15/16bt, 2: 24bit, 3: 32bit
818 Note: So far I've had better luck with: 0: 8/15/16bit, 1: 32bit??
819 4 (80x +) Hardware Cursor Right Storage. If set the cursor data is
820 stored in the last 256 bytes of 4 1Kyte lines (4bits/pixel) or the
821 last 512 bytes of 2 2Kbyte lines (8bits/pixel). Intended for
822 1280x1024 modes where there are no free lines at the bottom.
823 5 (928) Cursor Control Enable for Brooktree Bt485 DAC. If set and 3d4h
824 index 55h bit 5 is set the HC1 output becomes the ODF and the HC0
825 output becomes the CDE
826 (964) BT485 ODF Selection for Bt485A RAMDAC. If set pin 185 (RS3
827 /ODF) is the ODF output to a Bt485A compatible RamDAC (low for even
828 fields and high for odd fields), if clear pin185 is the RS3 output.
829 */
830 map(0x45, 0x45).lrw8(
831 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
832 const u8 res = s3.cursor_mode;
833 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
834 {
835 s3.cursor_fg_ptr = 0;
836 s3.cursor_bg_ptr = 0;
837 }
838 return res;
839 }),
840 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
841 s3.cursor_mode = data;
842 })
843 );
844 /*
845 CR46/7 Hardware Graphics Cursor Origin-X
846 bit 0-10 The HardWare Cursor X position. For 64k modes this value should be
847 twice the actual X co-ordinate.
848 */
849 map(0x46, 0x46).lrw8(
850 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
851 return (s3.cursor_x & 0xff00) >> 8;
852 }),
853 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
854 s3.cursor_x = (s3.cursor_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
855 })
856 );
857 map(0x47, 0x47).lrw8(
858 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
859 return s3.cursor_x & 0x00ff;
860 }),
861 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
862 s3.cursor_x = (s3.cursor_x & 0xff00) | data;
863 })
864 );
865 /*
866 CR48/9 Hardware Graphics Cursor Origin-Y
867 bit 0-9 (911/24) The HardWare Cursor Y position.
868 0-10 (80x +) The HardWare Cursor Y position.
869 Note: The position is activated when the high byte of the Y coordinate (index
870 48h) is written, so this byte should be written last (not 911/924 ?)
871 */
872 map(0x48, 0x48).lrw8(
873 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
874 return (s3.cursor_y & 0xff00) >> 8;
875 }),
876 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
877 s3.cursor_y = (s3.cursor_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
878 })
879 );
880 map(0x49, 0x49).lrw8(
881 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
882 return s3.cursor_y & 0x00ff;
883 }),
884 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
885 s3.cursor_y = (s3.cursor_y & 0xff00) | data;
886 })
887 );
888 /*
889 CR4A Hardware Graphics Cursor Foreground Stack (80x +)
890 bit 0-7 The Foreground Cursor color. Three bytes (4 for the 864/964) are
891 stacked here. When the Cursor Mode register (3d4h index 45h) is read
892 the stackpointer is reset. When a byte is written the byte is
893 written into the current top of stack and the stackpointer is
894 increased. The first byte written (item 0) is allways used, the
895 other two(3) only when Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch (3d4h
896 index 45h bit 2-3) is enabled.
897 */
898 map(0x4a, 0x4a).lrw8(
899 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
900 const u8 res = s3.cursor_fg[s3.cursor_fg_ptr];
901 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
902 {
903 s3.cursor_fg_ptr++;
904 s3.cursor_fg_ptr %= 4;
905 }
906 return res;
907 }),
908 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
909 s3.cursor_fg[s3.cursor_fg_ptr++] = data;
910 s3.cursor_fg_ptr %= 4;
911 })
912 );
913 /*
914 CR4B Hardware Graphics Cursor Background Stack (80x +)
915 bit 0-7 The Background Cursor color. Three bytes (4 for the 864/964) are
916 stacked here. When the Cursor Mode register (3d4h index 45h) is read
917 the stackpointer is reset. When a byte is written the byte is
918 written into the current top of stack and the stackpointer is
919 increased. The first byte written (item 0) is allways used, the
920 other two(3) only when Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch (3d4h
921 index 45h bit 2-3) is enabled.
922 */
923 map(0x4b, 0x4b).lrw8(
924 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
925 const u8 res = s3.cursor_bg[s3.cursor_bg_ptr];
926 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
927 {
928 s3.cursor_bg_ptr++;
929 s3.cursor_bg_ptr %= 4;
930 }
931 return res;
932 }),
933 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
934 s3.cursor_bg[s3.cursor_bg_ptr++] = data;
935 s3.cursor_bg_ptr %= 4;
936 })
937 );
938 /*
939 CR4C/D Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
940 bit 0-9 (911,924) HCS_STADR. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
941 0-11 (80x,928) HWGC_STA. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
942 0-12 (864,964) HWGC_STA. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
943 Address of the HardWare Cursor Map in units of 1024 bytes (256 bytes
944 for planar modes). The cursor map is a 64x64 bitmap with 2 bits (A
945 and B) per pixel. The map is stored as one word (16 bits) of bit A,
946 followed by one word with the corresponding 16 B bits.
947 The bits are interpreted as:
948 A B MS-Windows: X-11:
949 0 0 Background Screen data
950 0 1 Foreground Screen data
951 1 0 Screen data Background
952 1 1 Inverted screen Foreground
953 The Windows/X11 switch is only available for the 80x +.
954 (911/24) For 64k color modes the cursor is stored as one byte (8
955 bits) of A bits, followed by the 8 B-bits, and each bit in the
956 cursor should be doubled to provide a consistent cursor image.
957 (801/5,928) For Hi/True color modes use the Horizontal Stretch bits
958 (3d4h index 45h bits 2 and 3).
959 */
960 map(0x4c, 0x4c).lrw8(
961 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
962 return (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0xff00) >> 8;
963 }),
964 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
965 s3.cursor_start_addr = (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
966 })
967 );
968 map(0x4d, 0x4d).lrw8(
969 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
970 return s3.cursor_start_addr & 0x00ff;
971 }),
972 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
973 s3.cursor_start_addr = (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0xff00) | data;
974 })
975 );
976 /*
977 CR4E HGC Pattern Disp Start X-Pixel Position
978 bit 0-5 Pattern Display Start X-Pixel Position.
979 */
980 map(0x4e, 0x4e).lrw8(
981 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
982 return s3.cursor_pattern_x;
983 }),
984 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
985 s3.cursor_pattern_x = data;
986 })
987 );
988 /*
989 CR4F HGC Pattern Disp Start Y-Pixel Position
990 bit 0-5 Pattern Display Start Y-Pixel Position.
991 */
992 map(0x4f, 0x4f).lrw8(
993 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
994 return s3.cursor_pattern_y;
995 }),
996 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
997 s3.cursor_pattern_y = data;
998 })
999 );

1055 /*
1056 CR55 Extended Video DAC Control Register (80x +)
1057 bit 0-1 DAC Register Select Bits. Passed to the RS2 and RS3 pins on the
1058 RAMDAC, allowing access to all 8 or 16 registers on advanced RAMDACs.
1059 If this field is 0, 3d4h index 43h bit 1 is active.
1060 2 Enable General Input Port Read. If set DAC reads are disabled and the
1061 STRD strobe for reading the General Input Port is enabled for reading
1062 while DACRD is active, if clear DAC reads are enabled.
1063 3 (928) Enable External SID Operation if set. If set video data is
1064 passed directly from the VRAMs to the DAC rather than through the
1065 VGA chip
1066 4 Hardware Cursor MS/X11 Mode. If set the Hardware Cursor is in X11
1067 mode, if clear in MS-Windows mode
1068 5 (80x,928) Hardware Cursor External Operation Mode. If set the two
1069 bits of cursor data ,is output on the HC[0-1] pins for the video DAC
1070 The SENS pin becomes HC1 and the MID2 pin becomes HC0.
1071 6 ??
1072 7 (80x,928) Disable PA Output. If set PA[0-7] and VCLK are tristated.
1073 (864/964) TOFF VCLK. Tri-State Off VCLK Output. VCLK output tri
1074 -stated if set
1075 */
1076 map(0x55, 0x55).lrw8(
1077 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1078 return s3.extended_dac_ctrl;
1079 }),
1080 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1081 s3.extended_dac_ctrl = data;
1082 })
1083 );
1084 // External Sync Control 1 Register (EX_SYNC_1) (CR56)
1085 map(0x56, 0x56).lrw8(
1086 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1087 return s3.cr56;
1088 }),
1089 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1090 s3.cr56 = data & 0x1F; // bits 7-5 reserved
1091 })
1092 );
1093 // External Sync Control 2 Register (EX_SYNC_2) (CR57)
1094 map(0x57, 0x57).lrw8(
1095 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1096 return s3.cr57;
1097 }),
1098 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1099 s3.cr57 = data;
1100 })
1101 );
1102 // Linear Address Window Control Register (LAW_CTL) (CR58) - dosbox calls VGA_StartUpdateLFB() after storing the value
1103 map(0x58, 0x58).lrw8(
1104 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1105 return s3.cr58;
1106 }),

1111 })
1112 );
1113 // Linear Address Window Position High
1114 map(0x59, 0x59).lrw8(
1115 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1116 return s3.cr59;
1117 }),
1118 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1119 s3.cr59 = data;
1120 update_pci_bar0_from_crtc(u32(data) << 24, 0xff000000U);
1121 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
1122 })
1123 );
1124 // Linear Address Window Position Low
1125 map(0x5a, 0x5a).lrw8(
1126 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1127 return s3.cr5a;
1128 }),
1129 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1130 s3.cr5a = data;
1131 update_pci_bar0_from_crtc(u32(data) << 16, 0x00800000U);
1132 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
1133 })
1134 );
1135 // undocumented on trio64?
1136 map(0x5b, 0x5b).lrw8(
1137 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1138 return s3.cr5b;
1139 }),
1140 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1141 s3.cr5b = data;
1142 })
1143 );
1144 // TODO: bits 7-4 (w/o?) for GPIO
1145 map(0x5c, 0x5c).lr8(
1146 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1147 u8 res = 0;
1148 // if VGA dot clock is set to 3 (misc reg bits 2-3), then selected dot clock is read, otherwise read VGA clock select
1149 if ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) == 0x0c)
1150 res = s3.cr42 & 0x0f;
1151 else
1152 res = (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) >> 2;
1153 return res;
1154 })
1155 );
1156 // TODO: following two registers must be read-backable
1157 /*
1158 CR5D Extended Horizontal Overflow Register (80x +)
1159 bit 0 Horizontal Total bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Total register (3d4h
1160 index 0)
1161 1 Horizontal Display End bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Display End
1162 register (3d4h index 1)
1163 2 Start Horizontal Blank bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Start Blanking
1164 register (3d4h index 2).
1165 3 (864,964) EHB+64. End Horizontal Blank +64. If set the /BLANK pulse
1166 is extended by 64 DCLKs. Note: Is this bit 6 of 3d4h index 3 or
1167 does it really extend by 64 ?
1168 4 Start Horizontal Sync Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Start
1169 Retrace register (3d4h index 4).
1170 5 (864,964) EHS+32. End Horizontal Sync +32. If set the HSYNC pulse
1171 is extended by 32 DCLKs. Note: Is this bit 5 of 3d4h index 5 or
1172 does it really extend by 32 ?
1173 6 (928,964) Data Transfer Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Data Transfer
1174 Position register (3d4h index 3Bh)
1175 7 (928,964) Bus-Grant Terminate Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Bus Grant
1176 Termination register (3d4h index 5Fh).
1177 */
1178 map(0x5d, 0x5d).lrw8(
1179 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1180 // Recompose CR5D from the extended CRTC fields
1181 u8 res = 0;
1182 res |= (vga.crtc.horz_total >> 8) & 0x01; // bit 0
1183 res |= ((vga.crtc.horz_disp_end >> 7) & 0x02); // bit 1
1184 res |= s3.cr5d & 0x04; // bit 2
1185 // bit 3: EHB+64 extension — stored in s3.cr5d
1186 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0x08);
1187 res |= s3.cr5d & 0x10; // bit 4
1188 // bit 5: EHS+32 extension — stored in s3.cr5d
1189 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0x20);
1190 // bits 6-7: DTP bit8, BGT bit8 — stored in s3.cr5d
1191 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0xC0);
1192 return res;
1193 }),
1194 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1195 s3.cr5d = data; // ES40: cache for readback of non-decomposed bits
1196 vga.crtc.horz_total = (vga.crtc.horz_total & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x01) << 8);
1197 vga.crtc.horz_disp_end = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x02) << 7);
1198 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_start & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x04) << 6);
1199 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_end & 0xffbf) | ((data & 0x08) << 3);
1200 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x10) << 4);
1201 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end & 0xffdf) | (data & 0x20);
1202 s3_define_video_mode();
1203 // ES40 extension: recompute derived layout
1204 recompute_scanline_layout();
1205 })
1206 );
1207
1208 /*
1209 CR5E: Extended Vertical Overflow Register (80x +)
1210 bit 0 Vertical Total bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Total register (3d4h
1211 index 6). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 0 and 5.
1212 1 Vertical Display End bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Display End
1213 register (3d4h index 12h). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 1
1214 and 6
1215 2 Start Vertical Blank bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Start Blanking
1216 register (3d4h index 15h). Bit 8 is in 3d4h index 7 bit 3 and bit 9
1217 in 3d4h index 9 bit 5
1218 4 Vertical Retrace Start bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Start Retrace
1219 register (3d4h index 10h). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 2
1220 and 7.
1221 6 Line Compare Position bit 10. Bit 10 of the Line Compare register
1222 (3d4h index 18h). Bit 8 is in 3d4h index 7 bit 4 and bit 9 in 3d4h
1223 index 9 bit 6.
1224 */
1225 map(0x5e, 0x5e).lrw8(
1226 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1227 // Recompose CR5E from the extended CRTC fields
1228 u8 res = 0;
1229 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_total >> 10) & 0x01; // bit 0
1230 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_disp_end >> 9) & 0x02); // bit 1
1231 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_blank_start >> 8) & 0x04); // bit 2
1232 // bit 3: reserved
1233 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start >> 6) & 0x10); // bit 4
1234 // bit 5: reserved
1235 res |= ((vga.crtc.line_compare >> 4) & 0x40); // bit 6
1236 // bit 7: reserved
1237 return res;
1238 }),
1239 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1240 vga.crtc.vert_total = (vga.crtc.vert_total & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x01) << 10);
1241 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end = (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x02) << 9);
1242 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start = (vga.crtc.vert_blank_start & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x04) << 8);
1243 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start = (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x10) << 6);
1244 vga.crtc.line_compare = (vga.crtc.line_compare & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x40) << 4);
1245 s3_define_video_mode();
1246 })
1247 );
1248 map(0x5f, 0x5f).lrw8(
1249 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1250 return s3.cr5f;
1251 }),
1252 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1253 s3.cr5f = data;
1254 })
1255 );
1256 // Extended Memory Control 3 Register (EXT-MCTL-3) (CR60)
1257 map(0x60, 0x60).lrw8(
1258 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1259 return s3.cr60;
1260 }),
1261 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1262 s3.cr60 = data;
1263 })
1264 );
1265 // Extended Memory Control 4 Register (EXT-MCTL-4) (CR61)
1266 map(0x61, 0x61).lrw8(
1267 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1268 return s3.cr61;
1269 }),
1270 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1271 s3.cr61 = data;
1272 })
1273 );
1274 // undocumented?
1275 map(0x62, 0x62).lrw8(
1276 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1277 return s3.cr62;
1278 }),
1279 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1280 s3.cr62 = data;
1281 })
1282 );
1283 // External Sync Control 3 Register (EX-SYNC-3) (CR63)
1284 map(0x63, 0x63).lrw8(
1285 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1286 return s3.cr63;
1287 }),
1288 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1289 s3.cr63 = data;
1290 })
1291 );
1292 // undocumented?
1293 map(0x64, 0x64).lrw8(
1294 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1295 return s3.cr64;
1296 }),
1297 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1298 s3.cr64 = data;
1299 })
1300 );
1301 // Extended Miscellaneous Control Register (EXT-MISC-CTL) (CR6S)
1302 map(0x65, 0x65).lrw8(
1303 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1304 return s3.cr65;
1305 }),
1306 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1307 s3.cr65 = data;
1308 })
1309 );
1310 // Extended Miscellaneous Control 1 Register (EXT-MISC-1) (CR66) - S3 BIOS writes 0 here - normal operation & PCI bus disconnect disabled
1311 map(0x66, 0x66).lrw8(
1312 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1313 return s3.cr66;
1314 }),
1315 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1316 s3.cr66 = data;
1317 if (data & 0x02) {
1318 accel_reset();
1319 }
1320 })
1321 );
1322 map(0x67, 0x67).lrw8(
1323 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1324 return s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2;
1325 }),
1326 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1327 s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2 = data;
1328 s3_define_video_mode();
1329 })
1330 );
1331 map(0x68, 0x68).lrw8(
1332 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { // Configuration register 3
1333 // no /CAS,/OE stretch time, 32-bit data bus size
1334 return (s3.strapping & 0x00ff0000) >> 16;
1335 }),
1336 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1337 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
1338 {
1339 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1340 LOG("%s: CR68: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
1341 }
1342 })
1343 );
1344 map(0x69, 0x69).lrw8(
1345 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1346 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch >> 16;
1347 }),
1348 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1349 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~0x1f0000;
1350 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= ((data & 0x1f) << 16);
1351 s3_define_video_mode();
1352 })
1353 );
1354 map(0x6a, 0x6a).lrw8(
1355 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1356 return vga.crtc.data[0x6a] & 0x3f;
1357 }),
1358 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1359 vga.crtc.data[0x6a] = data;
1360 svga.bank_w = data & 0x3f;
1361 svga.bank_r = svga.bank_w;
1362 })
1363 );
1364 // Extended BIOS Flag 3 (CR6B), R/W BIOS scratchpad (DB014-B 17-14).
1365 // Trio64's BAR0 address aliases are CR59/CR5A; CR53[3] is reserved.
1366 map(0x6b, 0x6b).lrw8(
1367 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1368 return s3.cr6b;
1369 }),
1370 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1371 s3.cr6b = data;
1372 })
1373 );
1374 // Extended BIOS Flag 4 Register (EBIOS-FLG3) (CR6C) - Bios scratchpad
1375 map(0x6c, 0x6c).lrw8(
1376 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1377 return s3.cr6c;
1378 }),
1379 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1380 s3.cr6c = data;
1381 })
1382 );
1383 // undocumented
1384 map(0x6d, 0x6d).lrw8(
1385 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1386 return s3.cr6d;
1387 }),
1388 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1389 s3.cr6d = data;
1390 })
1391 );
1392 // Configuration register 4 (Trio64V+)
1393 map(0x6f, 0x6f).lrw8(
1394 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1395 // LPB(?) mode, Serial port I/O at port 0xe8, Serial port I/O disabled (MMIO only), no WE delay
1396 return (s3.strapping & 0xff000000) >> 24;
1397 }),
1398 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1399 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
1400 {
1401 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1402 LOG("%s: CR6F: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
1403 }
1404 })
1405 );
1406}

1408void CS3Trio64::sequencer_map(address_map& map)
1409{
1410 // TODO: legacy fallback trick
1411 map(0x00, 0xff).lr8(
1412 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1413 const u8 res = vga.sequencer.data[offset];
1414 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
1415 LOGREGS("%s: Reading unmapped sequencer read register [%02x] -> %02x (SVGA?)\n", devid_string, offset, res);
1416 return res;
1417 })
1418 );
1419 // map(0x00, 0x00) Reset Register
1420 map(0x00, 0x00).lw8( // es40 deviation
1421 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1422 if (seq_reset1() && ((data & 0x01) == 0))
1423 {
1424 vga.sequencer.data[3] = 0;
1425 vga.sequencer.char_sel.A = 0;
1426 vga.sequencer.char_sel.B = 0;
1427 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[0] = 0x20000;
1428 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[1] = 0x20000;
1429 m_output.display().lock();
1430 m_output.display().set_text_charmap(&vga.memory[0x20000]);
1431 m_output.display().unlock();
1432 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
1433 }
1434 vga.sequencer.data[0] = data;
1435 })
1436 );
1437 // map(0x01, 0x01) Clocking Mode Register
1438 // SR01: Clocking Mode Register
1439 map(0x01, 0x01).lw8( // es40 deviation
1440 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1441 u8 newreg1 = data & 0x3f;
1442 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x34) & 0x20) {
1443 newreg1 = (newreg1 & ~0x01) | (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x01);
1444 }
1445 vga.sequencer.data[1] = newreg1;
1446 })
1447 );
1448
1449 map(0x02, 0x02).lw8(
1450 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1451 vga.sequencer.map_mask = data & 0xf;
1452 })
1453 );
1454 // SR03: Character Map Select
1455 map(0x03, 0x03).lw8(
1456 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1457 /* --2- 84-- character select A
1458 ---2 --84 character select B */
1459 vga.sequencer.char_sel.A = (((data & 0xc) >> 2) << 1) | ((data & 0x20) >> 5);
1460 vga.sequencer.char_sel.B = (((data & 0x3) >> 0) << 1) | ((data & 0x10) >> 4);
1461 // optimization for screen update inner loop
1462 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[0] = 0x20000 + (vga.sequencer.char_sel.B * 0x2000);
1463 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[1] = 0x20000 + (vga.sequencer.char_sel.A * 0x2000);
1464 })
1465 );
1466 // Sequencer Memory Mode Register
1467// map(0x04, 0x04)
1468 map(0x04, 0x04).lw8(
1469 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1470 vga.sequencer.data[4] = data;
1471 })
1472 );
1473
1474 // (undocumented) Sequencer Horizontal Character Counter Reset
1475 // Any write strobe to this register will lock the character generator until another write to other regs happens.
1476 // map(0x07, 0x07)
1477 // TODO: SR8 (unlocks SRD)
1478 // SR08: PLL Unlock
1479 map(0x08, 0x08).lrw8(
1480 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x08]; }),
1481 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1482 vga.sequencer.data[0x08] = data;
1483 })
1484 );
1485 // SR09: Extended (reserved)
1486 map(0x09, 0x09).lrw8(
1487 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x09]; }),
1488 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1489 vga.sequencer.data[0x09] = data;
1490 })
1491 );
1492 // SR0A
1493 map(0x0a, 0x0a).lrw8(
1494 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0a]; }),
1495 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1496 vga.sequencer.data[0x0a] = data;
1497 })
1498 );
1499 // SR0B
1500 map(0x0b, 0x0b).lrw8(
1501 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0b]; }),
1502 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1503 vga.sequencer.data[0x0b] = data;
1504 })
1505 );
1506 // SR0D
1507 map(0x0d, 0x0d).lrw8(
1508 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0d]; }),
1509 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1510 vga.sequencer.data[0x0d] = data;
1511 })
1512 );
1513 // Memory CLK PLL
1514 map(0x10, 0x10).lrw8(
1515 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr10; }),
1516 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr10 = data; })
1517 );
1518 map(0x11, 0x11).lrw8(
1519 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr11; }),
1520 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr11 = data; })
1521 );
1522 // Video CLK PLL
1523 map(0x12, 0x12).lrw8(
1524 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr12; }),
1525 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr12 = data; load_dclk(); })
1526 );
1527 map(0x13, 0x13).lrw8(
1528 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr13; }),
1529 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr13 = data; load_dclk(); })
1530 );
1531 // SR14: CLKSYN Control 1
1532 map(0x14, 0x14).lrw8(
1533 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x14]; }),
1534 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1535 vga.sequencer.data[0x14] = data;
1536 })
1537 );
1538 map(0x15, 0x15).lrw8(
1539 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr15; }),
1540 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1541 s3.sr15 = data;
1542 load_dclk();
1543 })
1544 );
1545 map(0x17, 0x17).lr8(
1546 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1547 // CLKSYN test register
1548 const u8 res = s3.sr17;
1549 // who knows what it should return, docs only say it defaults to 0, and is reserved for testing of the clock synthesiser
1550 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
1551 s3.sr17--;
1552 return res;
1553 })
1554 );
1555 // SR18: RAMDAC/CLKSYN Control
1556 map(0x18, 0x18).lrw8(
1557 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr18; }),
1558 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1559 s3.sr18 = data;
1560 vga.sequencer.data[0x18] = data;
1561 })
1562 );
1563}
1564
1565uint8_t CS3Trio64::mem_r(uint32_t offset)
1566{
1567 // Standard MMIO (DB014-B 13.3.1): enhanced registers read at A8000h + their I/O address.
1568 // The packed 81xxh aliases are write-only and read back through AccelIORead's default.
1569 if ((s3.cr53 & 0x10) && offset >= 0x8000 && offset < 0x10000)
1570 return AccelIORead(offset);
1571
1572 if (svga.rgb8_en || svga.rgb15_en || svga.rgb16_en || svga.rgb32_en)
1573 {
1574 int data;
1575 if (offset & 0x10000)
1576 return 0;
1577 data = 0;
1578 if (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x8)
1579 {
1580 // DB014-B 15-2/17-13: enhanced CPU access shares the bank controls.
1581 const u8 bank = uses_sized_linear_bar_window() ?
1582 ((s3.memory_config & 0x01) ? cpu_bank() : 0) : svga.bank_r;
1583 if ((offset + (bank * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1584 data = vga.memory[(offset + (bank * 0x10000))];
1585 }
1586 else
1587 {
1588 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1589 {
1590 if (vga.sequencer.map_mask & 1 << i)
1591 {
1592 if ((offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1593 data |= vga.memory[(offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000))];
1594 }
1595 }
1596 }
1597 return (uint8_t)data;
1598 }
1599
1600 // Standard VGA fallback — full read-mode/latch pipeline via base class
1601 if ((offset + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1602 return CVGA::mem_r(offset);
1603 return 0xff;
1604}
1605
1606void CS3Trio64::mem_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data)
1607{
1608 ibm8514a_device* dev = get_8514();
1609 // bit 4 of CR53 enables memory-mapped I/O
1610 // 0xA0000-0xA7fff maps to port 0xE2E8 (pixel transfer)
1611 if (s3.cr53 & 0x10)
1612 {
1613 if (offset < 0x8000) {
1614 // Lower half of the MMIO window is PIX_TRANS FIFO.
1615 // Feed it through the same bus-size aware path as port I/O.
1616 AccelIOWrite(0xE2E8 + (offset & 3), data);
1617 return;
1618 }
1619
1620#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_MEMW
1621 printf("%s: Memory write offset=%05x data=%02x\n", devid_string, (unsigned)offset, (unsigned)data);
1622#endif
1623
1624 switch (offset)
1625 {
1626 case 0x8100:
1627 case 0x82e8:
1628 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0xff00) | data;
1629 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0xff00) | data;
1630 break;
1631 case 0x8101:
1632 case 0x82e9:
1633 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1634 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1635 break;
1636 case 0x8102:
1637 case 0x86e8:
1638 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0xff00) | data;
1639 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0xff00) | data;
1640 break;
1641 case 0x8103:
1642 case 0x86e9:
1643 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1644 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1645 break;
1646 case 0x8108:
1647 case 0x8ae8:
1648 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0xff00) | data;
1649 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0xff00) | data;
1650 break;
1651 case 0x8109:
1652 case 0x8ae9:
1653 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x3f) << 8);
1654 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
1655 break;
1656 case 0x810a:
1657 case 0x8ee8:

1659 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0xff00) | data;

1661 case 0x810b:

1664 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
1665 break;
1666 case 0x8118:
1667 case 0x9ae8:
1668 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0xff00) | data;
1669 break;
1670 case 0x8119:
1671 case 0x9ae9:
1672 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1673 dev->ibm8514_cmd_w(s3.mmio_9ae8);
1674 break;
1675 case 0x8120:
1676 case 0xa2e8:
1677 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xffffff00) | data;
1678 break;
1679 case 0x8121:
1680 case 0xa2e9:
1681 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1682 break;
1683 case 0x8122:
1684 case 0xa2ea:
1685 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1686 break;
1687 case 0x8123:
1688 case 0xa2eb:
1689 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1690 break;
1691 case 0x8124:
1692 case 0xa6e8:
1693 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xffffff00) | data;
1694 break;
1695 case 0x8125:
1696 case 0xa6e9:
1697 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1698 break;
1699 case 0x8126:
1700 case 0xa6ea:
1701 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1702 break;
1703 case 0x8127:
1704 case 0xa6eb:
1705 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1706 break;
1707 case 0x8128:
1708 case 0xaae8:
1709 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xffffff00) | data;
1710 break;
1711 case 0x8129:
1712 case 0xaae9:
1713 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1714 break;
1715 case 0x812a:
1716 case 0xaaea:
1717 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1718 break;
1719 case 0x812b:
1720 case 0xaaeb:
1721 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1722 break;
1723 case 0x812c:
1724 case 0xaee8:
1725 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xffffff00) | data;
1726 break;
1727 case 0x812d:
1728 case 0xaee9:
1729 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1730 break;
1731 case 0x812e:
1732 case 0xaeea:
1733 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1734 break;
1735 case 0x812f:
1736 case 0xaeeb:
1737 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1738 break;
1739 case 0x8130:
1740 case 0xb2e8:
1741 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xffffff00) | data;
1742 break;
1743 case 0x8131:
1744 case 0xb2e9:
1745 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1746 break;
1747 case 0x8132:
1748 case 0xb2ea:
1749 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1750 break;
1751 case 0x8133:
1752 case 0xb2eb:
1753 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1754 break;
1755 case 0xb6e8:
1756 case 0x8134:
1757 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0xff00) | data;
1758 break;
1759 case 0x8135:
1760 case 0xb6e9:
1761 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1762 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix >> 5) & 3;
1763 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x0f;
1764 break;
1765 case 0x8136:
1766 case 0xbae8:
1767 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0xff00) | data;
1768 break;
1769 case 0x8137:
1770 case 0xbae9:
1771 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1772 dev->ibm8514.frgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix >> 5) & 3;
1773 dev->ibm8514.frgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x0f;
1774 break;
1775 case 0x8138:
1776 dev->ibm8514.scissors_top = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_top & 0xff00) | data;
1777 break;
1778 case 0x8139:
1779 dev->ibm8514.scissors_top = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_top & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1780 break;
1781 case 0x813a:
1782 dev->ibm8514.scissors_left = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_left & 0xff00) | data;
1783 break;
1784 case 0x813b:
1785 dev->ibm8514.scissors_left = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_left & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1786 break;
1787 case 0x813c:
1788 dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom & 0xff00) | data;
1789 break;
1790 case 0x813d:
1791 dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1792 break;
1793 case 0x813e:
1794 dev->ibm8514.scissors_right = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_right & 0xff00) | data;
1795 break;
1796 case 0x813f:
1797 dev->ibm8514.scissors_right = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_right & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1798 break;
1799 case 0x8140:
1800 dev->ibm8514.pixel_control = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_control & 0xff00) | data;
1801 break;
1802 case 0x8141:
1803 dev->ibm8514.pixel_control = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_control & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1804 break;
1805 case 0x8146:
1806 dev->ibm8514.multifunc_sel = (dev->ibm8514.multifunc_sel & 0xff00) | data;
1807 break;
1808 case 0x8148:
1809 dev->ibm8514.rect_height = (dev->ibm8514.rect_height & 0xff00) | data;
1810 break;
1811 case 0x8149:
1812 dev->ibm8514.rect_height = (dev->ibm8514.rect_height & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1813 break;
1814 case 0x814a:
1815 dev->ibm8514.rect_width = (dev->ibm8514.rect_width & 0xff00) | data;
1816 break;
1817 case 0x814b:
1818 dev->ibm8514.rect_width = (dev->ibm8514.rect_width & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1819 break;
1820 case 0x8150: case 0x8151: case 0x8152: case 0x8153:
1821 // MMIO mirror of PIX_TRANS inside the upper half window.
1822 AccelIOWrite(0xE2E8 + (offset - 0x8150), data);
1823 break;
1824 case 0xbee8:
1825 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0xff00) | data;
1826 break;
1827 case 0xbee9:
1828 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1829 dev->ibm8514_multifunc_w(s3.mmio_bee8);
1830 break;
1831 case 0x96e8:
1832 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0xff00) | data;
1833 break;
1834 case 0x96e9:
1835 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1836 dev->ibm8514_width_w(s3.mmio_96e8);
1837 break;
1838 case 0x92e8:
1839 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0xff00) | data;
1840 break;
1841 case 0x92e9:
1842 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1843 dev->ibm8514_line_error_w(s3.mmio_92e8);
1844 break;
1845 case 0xe2e8: case 0xe2e9: case 0xe2ea: case 0xe2eb:
1846 // Normal PIX_TRANS MMIO addresses used by the VMS X11 driver
1847 AccelIOWrite(offset, data);
1848 break;
1849 default:
1850 LOG("%s: MMIO offset %05x write %02x\n", devid_string, offset + 0xa0000, data);
1851 break;
1852 }
1853 return;
1854 }
1855
1856 if (svga.rgb8_en || svga.rgb15_en || svga.rgb16_en || svga.rgb32_en)
1857 {
1858 if (offset & 0x10000)
1859 return;
1860 if (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x8)
1861 {
1862 const u8 bank = uses_sized_linear_bar_window() ?
1863 ((s3.memory_config & 0x01) ? cpu_bank() : 0) : svga.bank_w;
1864 if ((offset + (bank * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1865 vga.memory[(offset + (bank * 0x10000))] = data;
1866 }
1867 else
1868 {
1869 int i;
1870 for (i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1871 {
1872 if (vga.sequencer.map_mask & 1 << i)
1873 {
1874 if ((offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1875 vga.memory[(offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000))] = data;
1876 }
1877 }
1878 }
1879 return;
1880 }
1881
1882 if ((offset + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1883 CVGA::mem_w(offset, data);
1884}

1886uint32_t CS3Trio64::screen_update(bitmap_rgb32& bitmap, const rectangle& cliprect)
1887{
1888 CVGA::screen_update(bitmap, cliprect);
1889
1890 uint8_t cur_mode = pc_vga_choosevideomode();
1891
1892#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_RENDER
1893 static uint8_t last_mode = 0xff;
1894 if (cur_mode != last_mode) {
1895 LOGCRTC("%s: Screen mode changed to %d (rgb8=%d sync=%d graphic=%d)\n",
1896 devid_string, cur_mode, svga.rgb8_en, vga.crtc.sync_en, vga.gc.alpha_dis);
1897 LOGCRTC("%s: Visible area=(%d,%d)-(%d,%d) bitmap=%dx%d\n",
1898 devid_string, cliprect.min_x, cliprect.min_y, cliprect.max_x, cliprect.max_y,
1899 bitmap.width(), bitmap.height());
1900 LOGCRTC("%s: CRTC offset=%03x seq4=%02x chain4=%d height=%d lines=%d columns=%d\n",
1901 devid_string, vga.crtc.offset, vga.sequencer.data[4],
1902 (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x08) ? 1 : 0,
1903 vga.crtc.maximum_scan_line * (vga.crtc.scan_doubling + 1),
1904 (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end + 1), (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end + 1));
1905 last_mode = cur_mode;
1906 }
1907#endif
1908
1909 // draw hardware graphics cursor
1910 // TODO: support 16 bit and greater video modes
1911 // TODO: should be a derived function from svga_device
1912 if (s3.cursor_mode & 0x01) // if cursor is enabled
1913 {
1914 uint16_t cx = s3.cursor_x & 0x07ff;
1915 uint16_t cy = s3.cursor_y & 0x07ff;
1916
1917 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF || cur_mode == TEXT_MODE || cur_mode == MONO_MODE || cur_mode == CGA_MODE || cur_mode == EGA_MODE)
1918 return 0; // cursor only works in VGA or SVGA modes
1919
1920 uint32_t src = s3.cursor_start_addr * 1024; // start address is in units of 1024 bytes
1921
1922 uint32_t bg_col;
1923 uint32_t fg_col;
1924 int r, g, b;
1925 uint32_t datax;
1926 switch (cur_mode)
1927 {
1928 case RGB15_MODE:
1929 case RGB16_MODE:
1930 datax = s3.cursor_bg[0] | s3.cursor_bg[1] << 8;
1931 r = (datax & 0xf800) >> 11;
1932 g = (datax & 0x07e0) >> 5;
1933 b = (datax & 0x001f) >> 0;
1934 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
1935 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
1936 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
1937 bg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1938
1939 datax = s3.cursor_fg[0] | s3.cursor_fg[1] << 8;
1940 r = (datax & 0xf800) >> 11;
1941 g = (datax & 0x07e0) >> 5;
1942 b = (datax & 0x001f) >> 0;
1943 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
1944 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
1945 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
1946 fg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1947 break;
1948 case RGB24_MODE:
1949 case RGB32_MODE:
1950 datax = s3.cursor_bg[0] | s3.cursor_bg[1] << 8 | s3.cursor_bg[2] << 16;
1951 r = (datax & 0xff0000) >> 16;
1952 g = (datax & 0x00ff00) >> 8;
1953 b = (datax & 0x0000ff) >> 0;
1954 bg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1955
1956 datax = s3.cursor_fg[0] | s3.cursor_fg[1] << 8 | s3.cursor_fg[2] << 16;
1957 r = (datax & 0xff0000) >> 16;
1958 g = (datax & 0x00ff00) >> 8;
1959 b = (datax & 0x0000ff) >> 0;
1960 fg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1961 break;
1962 case RGB8_MODE:
1963 default:
1964 bg_col = pen(s3.cursor_bg[0]);
1965 fg_col = pen(s3.cursor_fg[0]);
1966 break;
1967 }
1968
1969 for (int y = 0; y < 64; y++)
1970 {
1971 if (cy + y < cliprect.max_y && cx < cliprect.max_x)
1972 {
1973 uint32_t* const dst = &bitmap.pix(cy + y, cx);
1974 for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++)
1975 {
1976 uint16_t bita = (vga.memory[(src + 1) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]
1977 | ((vga.memory[(src + 0) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
1978 >> (15 - (x % 16));
1979 uint16_t bitb = (vga.memory[(src + 3) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]
1980 | ((vga.memory[(src + 2) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
1981 >> (15 - (x % 16));
1982 uint8_t val = ((bita & 0x01) << 1) | (bitb & 0x01);
1983
1984 if (s3.extended_dac_ctrl & 0x10)
1985 { // X11 mode
1986 switch (val)
1987 {
1988 case 0x00: break; // no change
1989 case 0x01: break; // no change
1990 case 0x02: dst[x] = bg_col; break;
1991 case 0x03: dst[x] = fg_col; break;
1992 }
1993 }
1994 else
1995 { // Windows mode
1996 switch (val)
1997 {
1998 case 0x00: dst[x] = bg_col; break;
1999 case 0x01: dst[x] = fg_col; break;
2000 case 0x02: break; // screen data
2001 case 0x03: dst[x] = ~(dst[x]); break; // inverted
2002 }
2003 }
2004 if (x % 16 == 15)
2005 src += 4;
2006 }
2007 }
2008 }
2009 }
2010 return 0;
2011}

2026
2027// ES40 specific functions
2028
2029// Returns (A<<1)|B for pixel (sx,sy) from a 6464 cursor map.
2030// Supports:
2031// Standard layout (16 bytes/row): A[15:0] then B[15:0] per 16 px (all non-16bpp modes)
2032// 64k layout (16bpp): A byte then B byte per 8 px, each bit horizontally doubled.
2033// Right-storage addressing when CR45 bit4 is set - via MAME
2034static inline u8 s3_cursor_ab(const u8* vram, u32 vram_mask, u32 src_base, unsigned sx, unsigned sy, bool is16bpp, bool right_storage)
2035{
2036 // Compute row base with optional "right storage" skew.
2037 auto row_base_16bytes = [&](unsigned row) -> u32 {
2038 if (!right_storage) {
2039 return src_base + row * 16; // normal: 16 bytes/row
2040 }
2041 // right storage (non-16bpp path): last 256B of each 1KiB line, 4 lines 1KiB
2042 const unsigned lane = (row >> 4) & 0x3; // 0..3
2043 const unsigned r = row & 0x0F; // 0..15 within lane
2044 return src_base + lane * 1024u + (1024u - 256u) + r * 16u;
2045 };
2046
2047 if (!is16bpp) {
2048 // Standard 16B/row path: A[15:0] then B[15:0] per 16 pixels
2049 const unsigned group = sx >> 4; // 0..3
2050 const unsigned bit = 15 - (sx & 15);
2051 const u32 rb = row_base_16bytes(sy);
2052 const u32 src = rb + group * 4u;
2053 const u16 A = (u16)vram[(src + 1) & vram_mask] |
2054 ((u16)vram[(src + 0) & vram_mask] << 8);
2055 const u16 B = (u16)vram[(src + 3) & vram_mask] |
2056 ((u16)vram[(src + 2) & vram_mask] << 8);
2057 return (u8)(((A >> bit) & 1) << 1 | ((B >> bit) & 1));
2058 }
2059 else {
2060 // 64k (16bpp) path: one A byte + one B byte per 8 pixels, bits doubled horizontally.
2061 // We still keep 16 bytes per row total: 8 groups 2 bytes.
2062 // Right storage variant uses last 512B of 22KiB lines.
2063 u32 rb;
2064 if (!right_storage) {
2065 rb = src_base + sy * 16u;
2066 }
2067 else {
2068 const unsigned lane = (sy >> 5) & 0x1; // 0..1
2069 const unsigned r = sy & 0x1F; // 0..31
2070 rb = src_base + lane * 2048u + (2048u - 512u) + r * 16u;
2071 }
2072 const unsigned group8 = sx >> 3; // 0..7 (8px groups)
2073 const u32 src = rb + group8 * 2u; // A byte, then B byte
2074 const u8 Abits = vram[(src + 0) & vram_mask];
2075 const u8 Bbits = vram[(src + 1) & vram_mask];
2076 const unsigned bit = 7 - ((sx & 7) >> 1); // horizontal bit-doubling
2077 const u8 A = (Abits >> bit) & 1;
2078 const u8 B = (Bbits >> bit) & 1;
2079 return (u8)((A << 1) | B);
2080 }
2081}
2082
2093void CS3Trio64::run()
2094{
2095 try
2096 {
2097 // The GUI outlives this worker. Serial-menu save/restore stops and joins the worker.
2098 // Next run must retain the existing window.
2099 if (!m_gui_initialized)
2100 {
2101 // initialize the GUI (and let it know our tilesize)
2102 m_output.display().init(state.x_tilesize, state.y_tilesize);
2103 m_gui_initialized = true;
2104 }
2105 bool was_paused = false;
2106 PauseAck.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
2107 for (;;)
2108 {
2109 // Terminate thread if StopThread is set to true
2110 if (StopThread)
2111 return;
2112 // Handle GUI events (50 times per second)
2113 m_output.display().lock();
2114 m_output.display().handle_events();
2115 m_output.display().unlock();
2116 CThread::sleep(10);
2117
2118 // During firmware reset: keep pumping events (window stays alive),
2119 // but do NOT touch emulated VGA state.
2120 if (PauseThread.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
2121 {
2122 if (!was_paused)
2123 {
2124 m_output.display().lock();
2125 m_output.display().clear_screen(); // optional; comment out if you want last frame to remain
2126 m_output.display().unlock();
2127 was_paused = true;
2128 }
2129 PauseAck.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
2130 continue;
2131 }
2132 PauseAck.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
2133 was_paused = false;
2134
2135 //Update the screen (50 times per second)
2136 m_output.display().lock();
2137 update();
2138 m_output.display().flush();
2139 m_output.display().unlock();
2140 }
2141 }
2142
2143 catch (CException& e)
2144 {
2145 printf("%s: Exception in display thread: %s.\n", devid_string, e.displayText().c_str());
2146
2147 // Let the thread die...
2148 }
2149}
