4126
4130void CS3Trio64::check_state()
4131{
4132 if (myThread && !myThread->isRunning())
4133 FAILURE(Thread, "S3 thread has died");
4134}
4135
4136static u32 s3_magic1 = 0x53338811;
4137static u32 s3_magic2 = 0x88115333;
4138static const u32 s3_video_magic = 0x53335632; // S3V2, complete graphics state
4139
4140// The surrounding system format identifies compatible snapshots.
4141// Per-record sizes additionally reject a different structure layout.
4142template <typename T>
4143static bool s3_write_record(FILE* f, const T& value)
4144{
4145 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable<T>::value,
4146 "Saved graphics records must be trivially copyable");
4147 const u32 size = (u32)sizeof(T);
4148 return fwrite(&size, sizeof(size), 1, f) == 1 &&
4149 fwrite(&value, sizeof(value), 1, f) == 1;
4150}
4151
4152template <typename T>
4153static bool s3_read_record(FILE* f, T& value)
4154{
4155 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable<T>::value,
4156 "Saved graphics records must be trivially copyable");
4157 u32 size = 0;
4158 return fread(&size, sizeof(size), 1, f) == 1 && size == sizeof(T) &&
4159 fread(&value, sizeof(value), 1, f) == 1;
4160}
4161
4165int CS3Trio64::SaveState(FILE* f)
4166{
4167 if (!f || !vga.memory || !vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
4168 return -1;
4169 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
4170 const int res = CPCIDevice::SaveState(f);
4171 if (res)
4172 return res;
4173
4174 // Only serialize guest state. The VRAM allocation belongs to this process.
4175 auto saved_state = state;
4176 auto saved_vga = vga;
4177 saved_state.memory = nullptr;
4178 saved_vga.memory = nullptr;
4179 const u8 io_state[] = { (u8)m_ioas,
4180 m_video_subsys_enable, m_setup_option_select_0102 };
4181 const u32 vram_size = (u32)vga.svga_intf.vram_size;
4182
4183 if (fwrite(&s3_magic1, sizeof(s3_magic1), 1, f) != 1 ||
4184 fwrite(&s3_video_magic, sizeof(s3_video_magic), 1, f) != 1 ||
4185 !s3_write_record(f, saved_state) || !s3_write_record(f, saved_vga) ||
4186 !s3_write_record(f, s3) || !s3_write_record(f, svga) ||
4187 !s3_write_record(f, m_8514.ibm8514) || !s3_write_record(f, io_state) ||
4188 !s3_write_record(f, m_scan) ||
4189 fwrite(&vram_size, sizeof(vram_size), 1, f) != 1 ||
4190 fwrite(vga.memory, vram_size, 1, f) != 1 ||
4191 fwrite(&s3_magic2, sizeof(s3_magic2), 1, f) != 1)
4192 {
4193 printf("%s: Could not save graphics state.\n", devid_string);
4194 return -1;
4195 }
4196 printf("%s: Graphics registers and %u bytes of VRAM saved.\n",
4197 devid_string, vram_size);
4198 return 0;
4199}
4200
4204int CS3Trio64::RestoreState(FILE* f)
4205{
4206 if (!f || !vga.memory || !vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
4207 return -1;
4208 int res;
4209 {
4210 // Saved S3 aliases are loaded below. PCI replay must not normalize old
4211 // copies or mutate live graphics registers if the S3 section is rejected.
4212 struct ReplayGuard {
4213 bool& flag;
4214 bool previous;
4215 ~ReplayGuard() { flag = previous; }
4216 } guard{m_replaying_pci_state, m_replaying_pci_state};
4217 m_replaying_pci_state = true;
4218 res = CPCIDevice::RestoreState(f);
4219 }
4220 if (res)
4221 return res;
4222
4223 // Stage the complete graphics section so a short read or layout mismatch can't corrupt state.
4224 decltype(state) saved_state{};
4225 decltype(vga) saved_vga{};
4226 decltype(s3) saved_s3{};
4227 decltype(svga) saved_svga{};
4228 decltype(m_8514.ibm8514) saved_accel{};
4229 u8 io_state[3]{};
4230 ScanPosition saved_scan{};
4231 u32 magic = 0, video_magic = 0, vram_size = 0;
4232 if (fread(&magic, sizeof(magic), 1, f) != 1 || magic != s3_magic1 ||
4233 fread(&video_magic, sizeof(video_magic), 1, f) != 1 ||
4234 video_magic != s3_video_magic ||
4235 !s3_read_record(f, saved_state) || !s3_read_record(f, saved_vga) ||
4236 !s3_read_record(f, saved_s3) || !s3_read_record(f, saved_svga) ||
4237 !s3_read_record(f, saved_accel) || !s3_read_record(f, io_state) ||
4238 !s3_read_record(f, saved_scan) ||
4239 fread(&vram_size, sizeof(vram_size), 1, f) != 1 ||
4240 vram_size != vga.svga_intf.vram_size ||
4241 saved_vga.svga_intf.vram_size != vga.svga_intf.vram_size ||
4242 saved_state.memsize != state.memsize || io_state[0] > 1 ||
4243 (io_state[1] & ~0x18) || (io_state[2] & ~0x01) ||
4244 !std::isfinite(saved_scan.character) || saved_scan.character < 0.0 ||
4245 saved_scan.character >= 516.0 || saved_scan.line >= 4098 ||
4246 saved_scan.field > 1 ||
4247 (saved_scan.dclk_source != 0 && saved_scan.dclk_source != 1 &&
4248 saved_scan.dclk_source != 3))
4249 {
4250 printf("%s: Invalid or incompatible graphics state.\n", devid_string);
4251 return -1;
4252 }
4253
4254 std::vector<u8> saved_vram(vram_size);
4255 if (fread(saved_vram.data(), vram_size, 1, f) != 1 ||
4256 fread(&magic, sizeof(magic), 1, f) != 1 || magic != s3_magic2)
4257 {
4258 printf("%s: Incomplete graphics state.\n", devid_string);
4259 return -1;
4260 }
4261
4262 saved_state.memory = state.memory;
4263 saved_vga.memory = vga.memory;
4264 state = saved_state;
4265 vga = saved_vga;
4266 s3 = saved_s3;
4267 svga = saved_svga;
4268 m_8514.ibm8514 = saved_accel;
4269 m_ioas = io_state[0] != 0;
4270 m_video_subsys_enable = io_state[1];
4271 m_setup_option_select_0102 = io_state[2];
4272 m_scan = saved_scan;
4273 m_scan_time = cSystem->device_access_time();
4274 m_scan_initialized = true;
4275 // Preserve whether the caller stopped the VM. Normal System restore
4276 // resumes through start_threads; direct device restores remain runnable.
4277 memcpy(vga.memory, saved_vram.data(), vram_size);
4278
4279 // Rebuild host rendering caches from the restored registers.
4280 s3_define_video_mode();
4281 recompute_params();
4282 vga.dac.dirty = 1;
4283 if (m_gui_initialized)
4284 palette_update();
4285 else
4286 CVGA::palette_update();
4287 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
4288 state.last_bpp = 0;
4289 state.vga_mem_updated = true;
4290 m_frames_since_render = 0;
4291 m_last_refresh_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{};
4292 printf("%s: Graphics registers and %u bytes of VRAM restored.\n",
4293 devid_string, vram_size);
4294 return 0;
4295}
4296
4300u32 CS3Trio64::mem_read(u32 address, int dsize)
4301{
4302 const u32 mv = s3_vram_mask(); // (memsize - 1)
4303 const u32 off = address & mv;
4304
4305 switch (dsize) {
4306 case 8:
4307 return (u32)vga.memory[off];
4308 case 16:
4309 return (u32)vga.memory[off] | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] << 8);
4310 case 32:
4311 return (u32)vga.memory[off] | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] << 8) | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 2) & mv] << 16) | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 3) & mv] << 24);
4312 default:
4313 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4314 }
4315}
4316
4320void CS3Trio64::mem_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
4321{
4322 const u32 mv = s3_vram_mask(); // (memsize - 1)
4323 const u32 off = address & mv;
4324
4325 // Little-endian store into VRAM
4326 switch (dsize) {
4327 case 8:
4328 vga.memory[off] = (u8)data;
4329 break;
4330 case 16:
4331 vga.memory[off] = (u8)(data);
4332 vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 8);
4333 break;
4334 case 32:
4335 vga.memory[off] = (u8)(data);
4336 vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 8);
4337 vga.memory[(off + 2) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 16);
4338 vga.memory[(off + 3) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 24);
4339 break;
4340 default:
4341 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4342 }
4343
4344 // Mark the affected tiles dirty so update() will serialize to the screen.
4345 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
4346 if (vga.crtc.offset) {
4347 const unsigned nbytes = (dsize == 8) ? 1u : (dsize == 16 ? 2u : 4u);
4348 for (unsigned i = 0; i < nbytes; ++i) {
4349 const u32 p = (off + i) & mv;
4350 const u32 line = (vga.crtc.offset ? (p / vga.crtc.offset) : 0);
4351 const u32 col = (vga.crtc.offset ? (p % vga.crtc.offset) : 0);
4352 const unsigned xti = col / X_TILESIZE;
4353 const unsigned yti = line / Y_TILESIZE;
4354 }
4355 }
4356}
4357
4358
4361 *
4362 * Calls vga_mem_read to read the data 1 byte at a time.
4363 **/
4364u32 CS3Trio64::legacy_read(u32 address, int dsize)
4365{
4366 // MMIO alias active ?
4367 if (s3.cr53 & 0x10) {
4368 const u32 base = s3_mmio_base_off(state);
4369 if (address >= base && address <= base + 0xFFFFu) {
4370 const u32 off = address - base;
4371 if (off < 0x8000) {
4372 // PIX_TRANS read — same as MAME
4373 switch (dsize) {
4374 case 8: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8);
4375 case 16: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8);
4376 case 32: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8) |
4377 ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2EA) << 16) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2EB) << 24);
4378 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4379 }
4380 }
4381 // Upper half: register reads via AccelIORead
4382 if (IsAccelPort(off))
4383 return AccelIORead(off, dsize);
4384 }
4385 }
4386
4387 u32 data = 0;
4388 switch (dsize)
4389 {
4390 case 32:
4391 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 3) << 24;
4392 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 2) << 16;
4393 [[fallthrough]];
4394 case 16:
4395 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 1) << 8;
4396 [[fallthrough]];
4397 case 8:
4398 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 0);
4399 break;
4400 default:
4401 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4402 }
4403
4404 return data;
4405
4406}
4407
4413 // --- Legacy VGA memory write with S3 MMIO alias support ---
4414void CS3Trio64::legacy_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
4415{
4416 switch (dsize) {
4417 case 8:
4418 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
4419 break;
4420
4421 case 16:
4422 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
4423 mem_w(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4424 break;
4425
4426 case 32:
4427 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
4428 mem_w(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4429 mem_w(address + 2, (u8)(data >> 16));
4430 mem_w(address + 3, (u8)(data >> 24));
4431 break;
4432
4433 default:
4434 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4435 }
4436}
4437
4441u32 CS3Trio64::rom_read(u32 address, int dsize)
4442{
4443 if (dsize != 8 && dsize != 16 && dsize != 32)
4444 return 0;
4445
4446 // Preserve zero padding beyond the loaded image. Assemble bytes so reads
4447 // at the end of an image or the 64 KiB aperture never overrun the buffer.
4448 u32 data = 0;
4449 for (int byte = 0; byte < dsize / 8; ++byte)
4450 {
4451 const u64 offset = (u64)address + byte;
4452 if (offset < rom_max)
4453 data |= (u32)option_rom[offset] << (byte * 8);
4454 }
4455 return data;
4456}
4457
4461u32 CS3Trio64::io_read(u32 address, int dsize)
4462{
4463 if (!io_access_enabled(address, false))
4464 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : 0xffffffffU;
4465 if (address == 0x0102)
4466 {
4467 // Only the option byte is implemented; unused read lanes float high.
4468 switch (dsize) {
4469 case 8: return m_setup_option_select_0102;
4470 case 16: return 0xff00U | m_setup_option_select_0102;
4471 case 32: return 0xffffff00U | m_setup_option_select_0102;
4472 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4473 }
4474 }
4475 u32 data = 0;
4476 // Always intercept S3 8514/A-style ports. If the port block is not enabled
4477 // yet (CR40 == 0), hardware behaves benignly: reads return bus pull-ups,
4478 // writes are ignored.
4479 if (IsAccelPort(address)) {
4480 const bool ge_enabled = (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x40) & 0x01) != 0;
4481 if (!ge_enabled) {
4482 switch (dsize) {
4483 case 8: return 0xFF;
4484 case 16: return 0xFFFF;
4485 case 32: return 0xFFFFFFFF;
4486 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4487 }
4488 }
4489 return AccelIORead(address, dsize);
4490 }
4491
4492 if (dsize != 8)
4493 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4494
4495
4496 switch (address)
4497 {
4498 case 0x3c0:
4499 data = atc_address_r(0);
4500 break;
4501
4502 case 0x3c1:
4503 data = atc_data_r(0);
4504 break;
4505
4506 case 0x3c2:
4507 data = read_b_3c2();
4508 break;
4509
4510 case 0x3c4:
4511 data = sequencer_address_r(0);
4512 break;
4513
4514 case 0x3c5:
4515 if (vga.sequencer.index > 0x08 && vga.sequencer.data[0x08] != 0x06)
4516 data = vga.sequencer.data[vga.sequencer.index];
4517 else
4518 data = sequencer_data_r(0);
4519 break;
4520
4521 case 0x3c6:
4522 data = ramdac_mask_r(0);
4523 break;
4524
4525 case 0x3c7:
4526 data = ramdac_state_r(0);
4527 break;
4528
4529 case 0x3c8:
4530 data = ramdac_write_index_r(0);
4531 break;
4532
4533 case 0x3c9:
4534 data = ramdac_data_r(0);
4535 // DB014-B 14-49: valid palette reads expose six-bit components, even
4536 // from older saved bytes. Preserve undefined reads during write mode.
4537 if (vga.dac.read) data &= 0x3f;
4538 break;
4539
4540 case 0x3ca:
4541 data = read_b_3ca();
4542 break;
4543
4544 case 0x3cc:
4545 data = miscellaneous_output_r(0);
4546 break;
4547
4548 case 0x3ce:
4549 data = gc_address_r(0);
4550 break;
4551
4552 case 0x3cf:
4553 data = gc_data_r(0);
4554 break;
4555
4556 case 0x3b4:
4557 case 0x3d4:
4558 data = crtc_address_r(0);
4559 break;
4560
4561 case 0x3b5:
4562 case 0x3d5:
4563 data = crtc_data_r(0);
4564 break;
4565
4566 case 0x3ba:
4567 case 0x3da:
4568 {
4569 data = scan_status(cSystem->device_access_time());
4570 vga.attribute.state = 0; // ATC flip-flop reset
4571 break;
4572 }
4573
4574 case 0x3bb: /* Feature Control (mono) readback; mirror 3CA behavior */
4575 data = read_b_3ca();
4576 break;
4577 case 0x3db: /* Feature Control (color) readback; same treatment */
4578 data = read_b_3ca();
4579 break;
4580
4581 case 0x3b6:
4582 case 0x3b7:
4583 case 0x3b8:
4584 case 0x3b9:
4585 case 0x3d6:
4586 case 0x3d7:
4587 case 0x3d8:
4588 case 0x3d9:
4589 data = 0xFF; // open bus
4590 break;
4591
4592 default:
4593 printf("%s: Unhandled I/O port %x read.\n", devid_string, address);
4594 }
4595
4596 return data;
4597}
4598
4604void CS3Trio64::io_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
4605{
4606 if (IsAccelPort(address) && !normal_access_enabled())
4607 return;
4608 // 8514/A-style accel window (S3 engine). Intercept first, and swallow writes
4609 // until CR40 enables the port block (to avoid falling through to VGA path).
4610 if (IsAccelPort(address)) {
4611 const bool ge_enabled = (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x40) & 0x01) != 0;
4612 if (!ge_enabled) {
4613 // Ignore early probes safely (hardware no-op)
4614 return;
4615 }
4616#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4617 printf("%s: Accelerator I/O write port=%04x size=%d data=%08x\n",
4618 devid_string, (unsigned)address, dsize, (unsigned)data);
4619#endif
4620 switch (dsize) {
4621 case 8:
4622 AccelIOWrite(address, (u8)data);
4623 return;
4624 case 16:
4625 if (address == 0x42e8) {
4626 // SUBSYS_CNTL has action fields: apply both lanes once.
4627 m_8514.ibm8514_subcontrol_w(u16(data));
4628 s3.mmio_42e8 = m_8514.ibm8514_subcontrol_r();
4629 return;
4630 }
4631 AccelIOWrite(address + 0, (u8)(data & 0xFF));
4632 AccelIOWrite(address + 1, (u8)((data >> 8) & 0xFF));
4633 return;
4634 case 32:
4635 AccelIOWrite(address + 0, (u8)((data >> 0) & 0xFF));
4636 AccelIOWrite(address + 1, (u8)((data >> 8) & 0xFF));
4637 AccelIOWrite(address + 2, (u8)((data >> 16) & 0xFF));
4638 AccelIOWrite(address + 3, (u8)((data >> 24) & 0xFF));
4639 return;
4640 default:
4641 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4642 }
4643 }
4644
4645 switch (dsize)
4646 {
4647 case 8:
4648 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4649 break;
4650
4651 case 16:
4652 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4653 io_write_b(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4654 break;
4655
4656 case 32:
4657#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_NOISY
4658 printf("%s: I/O write port=%04" PRIx32 " size=%d data=%08" PRIx32 "\n", devid_string, address, dsize, data);
4659#endif
4660 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4661 io_write_b(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4662 io_write_b(address + 2, (u8)(data >> 16));
4663 io_write_b(address + 3, (u8)(data >> 24));
4664 break;
4665
4666 default:
4667#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4668 printf("%s: I/O write port=%04" PRIx32 " size=%d data=%08" PRIx32 "\n", devid_string, address, dsize, data);
4669#endif
4670 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Weird IO size");
4671 }
4672}
4673
4674// Shared by normal target writes and already-qualified passive writes.
4675// Keep access/lock checks at the caller so observers use captured eligibility.
4676void CS3Trio64::ramdac_write_b(u32 address, u8 data)
4677{
4678 switch (address)
4679 {
4680 case 0x3c6: ramdac_mask_w(0, data); break;
4681 case 0x3c7: ramdac_read_index_w(0, data); break;
4682 case 0x3c8: ramdac_write_index_w(0, data); break;
4683 case 0x3c9: ramdac_data_w(0, data); break;
4684 }
4685}
4686
4690void CS3Trio64::io_write_b(u32 address, u8 data)
4691{
4692 if (!io_access_enabled(address, true))
4693 return;
4694 // Finish elapsed scan time with the old registers before a timing write.
4695 // Every claimant in this PCI transaction receives the same sampled instant.
4696 if (address == 0x3c2 || address == 0x3c5 ||
4697 address == 0x3b5 || address == 0x3d5)
4698 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
4699 switch (address)
4700 {
4701 case 0x3c0:
4702 {
4703 bool was_index_phase = (vga.attribute.state == 0);
4704 // Snapshot previous video-enabled state BEFORE the MAME canonical write
4705 bool prev_ve = atc_video_enabled();
4706 atc_address_data_w(0, data);
4707 if (was_index_phase) {
4708 // Detect video enable/disable transitions from MAME canonical source
4709 bool new_ve = atc_video_enabled();
4710 if (!new_ve && prev_ve) {
4711 m_output.display().lock();
4712 m_output.display().clear_screen();
4713 m_output.display().unlock();
4714 }
4715 else if (new_ve && !prev_ve) {
4716 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
4717 }
4718 }
4719 break;
4720 }
4721
4722 case 0x3c2:
4723 write_b_3c2(data);
4724 m_ioas = bool(BIT(data, 0));
4725 break;
4726
4727 case 0x3c3:
4728 case 0x46E8:
4729 // Address selection and access were checked above; reserved bits read 0.
4730 m_video_subsys_enable = data & 0x18;
4731 break;
4732
4733 case 0x3c4:
4734 sequencer_address_w(0, data);
4735 break;
4736
4737 case 0x3c5:
4738 // PLL lock gate: SR09+ requires SR08 == 0x06
4739 if (vga.sequencer.index > 0x08 && vga.sequencer.data[0x08] != 0x06)
4740 break;
4741 // SR1A/SR1B: not in sequencer_map, but in 86box
4742 if (vga.sequencer.index == 0x1a) { s3.sr1a = data; break; }
4743 if (vga.sequencer.index == 0x1b) { s3.sr1b = data; break; }
4744 sequencer_data_w(0, data);
4745 break;
4746
4747 case 0x3c6:
4748 case 0x3c7:
4749 case 0x3c8:
4750 case 0x3c9:
4751 // CR33.4 locks all RAMDAC writes, including 3C7 (DB014-B 12-2).
4752 if (!(s3.cr33 & 0x10))
4753 ramdac_write_b(address, data);
4754 break;
4755
4756 case 0x3ce:
4757 gc_address_w(0, data);
4758 break;
4759
4760 case 0x3cf:
4761 gc_data_w(0, data);
4762 break;
4763
4764 case 0x3ba:
4765 case 0x3da:
4766 feature_control_w(0, data);
4767 break;
4768
4769 case 0x3b4:
4770 case 0x3d4:
4771 vga.crtc.index = data & 0x7f;
4772 break;
4773
4774 case 0x3b5:
4775 case 0x3d5:
4776 crtc_data_w(0, data);
4777 break;
4778
4779 case 0x3bb:
4780 break;
4781
4782 case 0x3b6:
4783 case 0x3b7:
4784 case 0x3b8:
4785 case 0x3b9:
4786 case 0x3d6:
4787 case 0x3d7:
4788 case 0x3d8:
4789 case 0x3d9:
4790 // Dead ports — 32-bit writes to the CRTC pair (3D4/3D5) spill here.
4791 // Real hardware silently ignores them.
4792 break;
4793
4794 case 0x0102:
4795 m_setup_option_select_0102 = data & 0x01;
4796 break;
4797
4798 default:
4799#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4800 printf("%s: Unhandled I/O write port=%04x data=%02x\n", devid_string, address, data);
4801#endif
4802 FAILURE_1(NotImplemented, "Unhandled port %x write", address);
4803 }
4804}

4841void CS3Trio64::write_b_3c2(u8 value)
4842{
4843 // ES40 extension: CR34 bit7 locks clock select bits
4844 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x34) & 0x80) {
4845 // Preserve current clock_select (bits 3:2), take everything else from value
4846 value = (value & ~0x0C) | (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x0C);
4847 }
4848
4849 // MAME canonical store (flat byte)
4850 vga.miscellaneous_output = value;
4851 load_dclk();
4852
4853#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_NOISY
4854 printf("%s: Miscellaneous output=%02x color=%u RAM=%u clock=%u "
4855 "high_bank=%u hsync_polarity=%u vsync_polarity=%u\n",
4856 devid_string, value, unsigned(BIT(value, 0)), unsigned(BIT(value, 1)), unsigned((value >> 2) & 3),
4857 unsigned(BIT(value, 5)), unsigned(BIT(value, 6)), unsigned(BIT(value, 7)));
4858#endif
4859}

4866
4875u8 CS3Trio64::read_b_3c2()
4876{
4877 u8 res = 0x60; // is VGA (bits 5-6 set)
4878
4879 // Sense bit readback: select which of 4 sense switches based on clock select
4880 // MAME: const u8 sense_bit = (3 - (vga.miscellaneous_output >> 2)) & 3;
4881 // if(BIT(m_input_sense->read(), sense_bit)) res |= 0x10;
4882 const u8 sense_bit = (3 - ((vga.miscellaneous_output >> 2) & 3)) & 3;
4883 if (BIT(0x0F, sense_bit)) // all sense pins active
4884 res |= 0x10;
4885
4886 res |= vga.crtc.irq_latch << 7;
4887 return res;
4888}

4909void CS3Trio64::update(void)
4910{
4911 unsigned iWidth = 0, iHeight = 0;
4912
4913 /* no screen update necessary
4914 Trio32/Trio64: SR0 reset bits are not functional
4915 Gate on ATC video enable and SR1 "Screen Off" */
4916 // Setup/sleep controls CPU access; existing video output continues (14-47).
4917 if (!atc_video_enabled())
4918 return;
4919
4920 const bool screen_off = (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x20) != 0; // SR1 bit5
4921 if (screen_off)
4922 return;
4923
4924 auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
4925 auto elapsed_ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
4926 now - m_last_refresh_time).count();
4927
4928 if (elapsed_ms < (long long)timing.refresh_interval_ms)
4929 return;
4930 m_last_refresh_time = now;
4931
4932 const uint8_t cur_mode = pc_vga_choosevideomode();
4933
4934 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF)
4935 {
4936 state.vga_mem_updated = 0;
4937 return;
4938 }
4939
4940 // Dirty-gate: re-rasterize + re-upload only when something visible changed. vga_mem_updated covers
4941 // VRAM + CRTC text-cursor + palette + mode writes; the S3 hardware cursor (mode/pos/data-addr) is not
4942 // flagged, so fold it into a signature. Force a refresh every few frames so the cursor / blinking text
4943 // still animate on an otherwise static screen; tick_frame() keeps the blink counter advancing on the
4944 // skip path so blink timing stays correct.
4945 const int kBlinkRefreshFrames = 8; // >= 2x the ~1.9 Hz VGA blink toggle at a 60 Hz refresh
4946 const uint64_t cursor_sig = ((uint64_t) s3.cursor_mode << 56)
4947 | ((uint64_t) s3.cursor_start_addr << 24)
4948 | ((uint64_t) (s3.cursor_x & 0x7FF) << 12)
4949 | (uint64_t) (s3.cursor_y & 0x7FF);
4950 if (!state.vga_mem_updated && cursor_sig == m_last_cursor_sig
4951 && ++m_frames_since_render < kBlinkRefreshFrames)
4952 {
4953 screen().tick_frame(); // keep cursor/text-blink timing alive while skipping the render
4954 return;
4955 }
4956 m_frames_since_render = 0;
4957 m_last_cursor_sig = cursor_sig;
4958
4959 vga.crtc.start_addr = vga.crtc.start_addr_latch; // FIXME: Figure out proper handling, but makes BSD happy again....
4960 vga.attribute.pel_shift = vga.attribute.pel_shift_latch;
4961
4962 get_display_size(iWidth, iHeight);
4963
4964 if (iWidth == 0 || iHeight == 0)
4965 return;
4966
4967 // Update screen shim's visible area
4968 screen().set_visible_area(iWidth, iHeight);
4969
4970 // Ensure bitmap is large enough
4971 m_render_bitmap.allocate(iWidth, iHeight);
4972
4973 // Render via MAME's screen_update pipeline
4974 rectangle clip = m_render_bitmap.cliprect();
4975 screen_update(m_render_bitmap, clip);
4976
4977 // Tick the frame counter (for cursor blink)
4978 screen().tick_frame();
4979
4980 // MAME always produces ARGB32 — tell SDL we're in 32bpp mode.
4981 if (state.last_bpp != 32 || iWidth != old_iWidth || iHeight != old_iHeight)
4982 {
4983 m_output.display().dimension_update(iWidth, iHeight, 0, 0, 32);
4984 old_iWidth = iWidth;
4985 old_iHeight = iHeight;
4986 state.last_bpp = 32;
4987 }
4988
4989 m_output.display().graphics_frame_update(m_render_bitmap.raw(), iWidth, iHeight);
4990
4991 state.vga_mem_updated = 0;
4992}

4994// Active display from the display-end registers, which already carry the CR07
4995// and S3 CR5D/CR5E overflow bits; char clocks scaled by the colour-mode divisor.
4996void CS3Trio64::get_display_size(unsigned& width, unsigned& height)
4997{
4998 width = height = 0;
4999 if (!vga.crtc.horz_disp_end || !vga.crtc.vert_disp_end)
5000 return;
5001
5002 const unsigned char_clocks = GRAPHIC_MODE ? 8 : VGA_CH_WIDTH;
5003 const unsigned divisor = timing.divisor > 0 ? (unsigned)timing.divisor : 1;
5004 width = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end + 1u) * char_clocks / divisor;
5005 height = LINES;
5006}

5014void CS3Trio64::palette_update()
5015{
5016 CVGA::palette_update();
5017
5018 for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
5019 // pal6bit: expand 6-bit color to 8-bit
5020 u8 r = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 0] & 0x3f);
5021 u8 g = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 1] & 0x3f);
5022 u8 b = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 2] & 0x3f);
5023 // Expand 6-bit to 8-bit: (val << 2) | (val >> 4)
5024 r = (r << 2) | (r >> 4);
5025 g = (g << 2) | (g >> 4);
5026 b = (b << 2) | (b >> 4);
5027 m_output.display().palette_change((unsigned)i, (unsigned)r, (unsigned)g, (unsigned)b);
5028 }
5029}

5052// Draws the 64x64 S3 hardware graphics cursor over a pre-rendered framebuffer.
5053// Supports Windows mode and X11 mode (CR55 bit 4), and all color depths.
5054void CS3Trio64::s3_draw_hardware_cursor(
5055 uint32_t* pixels, int pitch_px,
5056 int clip_width, int clip_height,
5057 uint8_t cur_mode)
5058{
5059 // Only draw if cursor is enabled
5060 if (!(s3.cursor_mode & 0x01))
5061 return;
5062
5063 // Cursor only works in VGA or SVGA modes
5064 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF || cur_mode == TEXT_MODE ||
5065 cur_mode == MONO_MODE || cur_mode == CGA_MODE ||
5066 cur_mode == EGA_MODE)
5067 return;
5068
5069 uint16_t cx = s3.cursor_x & 0x07FF;
5070 uint16_t cy = s3.cursor_y & 0x07FF;
5071
5072 // Start address is in units of 1024 bytes
5073 uint32_t src = (uint32_t)s3.cursor_start_addr * 1024;
5074
5075 // Decode foreground/background colors
5076 uint32_t bg_col, fg_col;
5077
5078 auto decode_rgb16 = [](const uint8_t* raw) -> uint32_t {
5079 uint32_t datax = raw[0] | (raw[1] << 8);
5080 int r = (datax & 0xF800) >> 11;
5081 int g = (datax & 0x07E0) >> 5;
5082 int b = (datax & 0x001F) >> 0;
5083 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
5084 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
5085 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
5086 return 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
5087 };
5088
5089 auto decode_rgb24 = [](const uint8_t* raw) -> uint32_t {
5090 uint32_t datax = raw[0] | (raw[1] << 8) | (raw[2] << 16);
5091 int r = (datax & 0xFF0000) >> 16;
5092 int g = (datax & 0x00FF00) >> 8;
5093 int b = (datax & 0x0000FF) >> 0;
5094 return 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
5095 };
5096
5097 switch (cur_mode)
5098 {
5099 case RGB15_MODE:
5100 case RGB16_MODE:
5101 bg_col = decode_rgb16(s3.cursor_bg);
5102 fg_col = decode_rgb16(s3.cursor_fg);
5103 break;
5104
5105 case RGB24_MODE:
5106 case RGB32_MODE:
5107 bg_col = decode_rgb24(s3.cursor_bg);
5108 fg_col = decode_rgb24(s3.cursor_fg);
5109 break;
5110
5111 case RGB8_MODE:
5112 default:
5113 bg_col = pen(s3.cursor_bg[0]);
5114 fg_col = pen(s3.cursor_fg[0]);
5115 break;
5116 }
5117
5118 // Draw the 64x64 cursor bitmap
5119 // Cursor data: 64 rows, each row = 16 bytes (4 words of 16 bits A + 16 bits B)
5120 // Pattern origin offset from CR4E/CR4F
5121 const int pat_x = s3.cursor_pattern_x & 0x3F;
5122 const int pat_y = s3.cursor_pattern_y & 0x3F;
5123
5124 for (int y = 0; y < 64; y++)
5125 {
5126 int screen_y = cy + y - pat_y;
5127 if (screen_y < 0 || screen_y >= clip_height)
5128 {
5129 // Still need to advance src through the row's cursor data
5130 // Each row: 4 groups of 4 bytes = 16 bytes
5131 // But we advance per-group below, so just skip
5132 // We need 4 groups * 4 bytes = 16 bytes per row
5133 src += 16; // skip this row's data
5134 continue;
5135 }
5136
5137 uint32_t* dst = pixels + (screen_y * pitch_px);
5138 uint32_t row_src = src;
5139
5140 for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++)
5141 {
5142 // Each 16-pixel group uses 4 bytes: 2 bytes for A-plane, 2 for B-plane
5143 // Bit extraction from MAME:
5144 uint16_t bita = (vga.memory[(row_src + 1) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size] |
5145 ((vga.memory[(row_src + 0) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
5146 >> (15 - (x % 16));
5147 uint16_t bitb = (vga.memory[(row_src + 3) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size] |
5148 ((vga.memory[(row_src + 2) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
5149 >> (15 - (x % 16));
5150 uint8_t val = ((bita & 0x01) << 1) | (bitb & 0x01);
5151
5152 int screen_x = cx + x - pat_x;
5153 if (screen_x >= 0 && screen_x < clip_width)
5154 {
5155 if (s3.extended_dac_ctrl & 0x10)
5156 {
5157 // X11 mode
5158 switch (val)
5159 {
5160 case 0x00: /* no change - transparent */ break;
5161 case 0x01: /* no change - transparent */ break;
5162 case 0x02: dst[screen_x] = bg_col; break;
5163 case 0x03: dst[screen_x] = fg_col; break;
5164 }
5165 }
5166 else
5167 {
5168 // Windows mode
5169 switch (val)
5170 {
5171 case 0x00: dst[screen_x] = bg_col; break;
5172 case 0x01: dst[screen_x] = fg_col; break;
5173 case 0x02: /* screen data - no change */ break;
5174 case 0x03: dst[screen_x] = ~(dst[screen_x]); break; // invert
5175 }
5176 }
5177 }
5178
5179 // Advance source pointer every 16 pixels
5180 if (x % 16 == 15)
5181 row_src += 4;
5182 }
5183 src = row_src; // advance to next row
5184 }
5185}
